Tyoharon par mehmanon ke lie bar-bar nashta banane ki jarurat nahin. is bar ghar par banaie besan ka kurkura papar. yah ek aasan aur svadisht instent snaik hai, jise pahle se banakar rakha ja sakta hai. chay ke sath khaie ya mehmanon ko parosie, har tarah se majedar. Diwali Special besan ka papar banane ki vidhi, Step by Step Besan Papad Recipe
Ingredients for Besan Papdi
Besan - Gram Flour - 1 cup (110g)
Urad dal - Urad Dal - ¼ cup (50g)
Namak - Salt - ¾ tsp
Ajvain - Carom Seeds - ½ tsp
Beking soda - Baking Soda - ⅛ tsp
Haldi paudar - Turmeric Powder - 2 pinch
